prose.text: The gates: - escher-driver's unit tests; - the two new stand targets; - the blitz-tests companions the diff moves; - seven_guis' four process checks; - the two CI-script tests; - the lock guard; - the pre-push gate (`fast`); - the `doc` leg. The chunk edits public doc comments (`Harness`, `Session`, `Command`, `Outcome`, `FieldKind`, the   crate doc, a new public read in blitz-paint), and `fast` runs no rustdoc (test-plan ·   decision/doc-leg-gates-public-doc-edits); - the `audit` leg. escher-driver takes two dependencies; the fast leg runs no audit (security-plan ·   decision/local-audit-before-push); - `stand-repeat`. Both new targets are `stand_` files, so they run by its glob.

What is absent: - No boot-path touchpoint changes a binary's start: `session_host.rs` is untouched. `cli_commands`, `mcp_server`,   `host_log` and `mcp_log` drive both binaries' roles and stand in for the smoke. - There is no live leg: the cold-agent pipe takes the tool into its lists and runs no live run. - There is no headful self-verify harness in this project, and this is no UI chunk. - The coverage leg is not run locally. CI's coverage job reads escher-driver's 97 % and blitz-test-harness's 90 %   floors on the pushed tree, and the CI read below asserts green over it.

Each new check is controlled red-before-green (tests S4). After the steps are green, /implement makes four one-shot `gate.py control` runs, never entries. Each names the edit's text and the case by its test name (gate-contract.md §Control), and each enters with the red reading it must produce: - **The read reaching a pass.**   - Edit: the `Command::Canvas` arm in `execute.rs` calls `self.harness.pump()` before `self.canvas(id)`.   - Fired on: the `stand_canvas_commands` entry, case `a_canvas_read_changes_nothing_with_timer_ticks_pending`.   - Red reading: the delivered ticks read applied after the call, `timer-elapsed`'s name moving. - **Glyph ids written.**   - Edit: `json.rs` writes the `glyphs` line's `ids=` as the glyph ids joined by `,` in place of the digest.   - Fired on: the new-targets entry, case `the_fixtures_answers_hold_no_glyph_id_and_no_text`.   - Red reading: the `ids` value is not 16 lowercase hex. - **Exploration's canvas filter removed.**   - Edit: `explorable` in `explore.rs` no longer leaves out the `Commands` and `CommandCounts` kinds.   - Fired on: the escher-driver unit entry, case     `the_verbs_explored_are_the_tables_target_verbs_with_no_image_no_layout_and_no_canvas_reading`.   - Red reading: `canvas` among the explored verbs. - **The budget doubled.**   - Edit: the canvas cut in `execute.rs` measures parts against `2 * SNAPSHOT_TEXT_BUDGET`. A control removing a bound     loosens it to twice the budget (test-plan · decision/mutation-controlled-tests).   - Fired on: the `stand_canvas_commands` entry, case `a_full_dump_over_the_budget_reads_in_parts_each_within_it`.   - Red reading: a part over 10,000 bytes and the 100-circle dump read in fewer parts than its table row.

An acceptance reads CI: the windows and macOS legs hold the canvas table and the re-read `actions` digests, and CI's coverage job holds the floors. So the operator's hygiene, push and CI entries stand. The diff is OS-sensitive in two ways, and the `ci.py` entry's note names both: - the `cfg(unix)` items of the new socket and kept-check tests: the windows leg runs the in-process and MCP tests   alone; - the committed digest tables.
